name: codex-monitor-hud
description: A local real-time multi-task HUD for Codex Desktop, VS Code, and CLI on Windows.

interface.shortDescription: Local live monitoring for concurrent Codex tasks.
interface.longDescription: A local-first real-time HUD for high-concurrency Codex Desktop, VS Code, and CLI workflows on Windows. Distinct source badges separate Desktop, VS Code, OpenAI CLI, and an isolated DeepSeek CLI profile. Keep one compact summary, expand a stable numbered task list, split selected tasks into independent bubbles, or opt in to source-aware CODEX-labeled mid-task notices while Codex keeps working in the background.
defaultPrompt: Explain and configure proactive Codex notices
Repair or restart Codex Monitor HUD
